testCase.name: [本地] S22 Every empty and failure screen passes axe, is announced, and fits phone widths and WebKit

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A2 · P2 · 无障碍

状态和错误不播报：报错、无搜索结果、Ask AI 的回答、「Listening…」都不读出来；开关没有选中 / 按下状态

票：TFA-94745 等 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S22 「每个空状态和失败页面都过 axe、会被读出来，并且在手机宽度和 WebKit 上放得下」 Every empty and failure screen passes axe, is announced, and fits phone widths and WebKit

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Empty patient list: a clear empty state with a way to add patients (scan or "+").（UAT EFS state 1；TFA-94745 state 1）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content.（UAT EFS intro；UAT 3.4；TFA-94745 AC 2）
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android.（UAT EFS Expected Result；UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane profiles desktop Chrome, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit), each with every state on screen: empty lists (both contexts, both Nursing Home views), no-note Post-Round, summary-failure editor, Generate-blocked reason, note-failure message, billing error, Ask AI error, scan error, microphone message, …

When Run axe-core (WCAG 2 A/AA) and the page checks on each state per profile, and screenshot it

Then No axe violations; each failure message sits in a role=alert or role=status region so a screen reader announces it; the add (+), scan and Settings controls on the empty lists have accessible names. On every profile no message is truncated, covered or pushed off screen, there is no sideways scroll, and the add, scan, retry and Dictate controls are at least 2 …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe violations = 0 per screen and the message element's role is alert or status; visual-checks.ts covered / overflow / truncated / tap findings = 0 per screen; vision-review.sh compares the screenshots. On main the Nursing Home '+' and Settings buttons have no title or aria-label, so a button-name violation is expected; findings are evidence for a person. Merges the former S25

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94745 ready for qa

读屏用户听不到三种失败提示（医院预查房摘要失败、医院麦克风被禁、两种模式下照片读不出）；养老院空列表的 + 和 Settings 按钮只被读成「button」；手机上养老院麦克风被禁的提示条盖住编辑器标题和关闭按钮，多个按钮小于 44 pt。

Screen-reader users are not told about three failures (Hospital pre-round summary failed, Hospital microphone blocked, unreadable scan photo in both modes); the Nursing Home empty list's + and Settings buttons are read only as 'button'; on phones the Nursing Home microphone-blocked toast covers the editor title and Close button, and several buttons are under 44 pt.

依据：allure 1dd42d85-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/EFS_S22 (desktop, iPhone 15, Pixel 7): 438 checks pass, 98 fail. Messages lack role=alert/status; NH +/Settings unnamed (expected in the matrix oracle); Pixel 7 unnamed 20×20 px close (X) on the Ask and scan sheets fails WCAG 2.5.8; also contrast failures. Recorded only: with the microphone blocked both editors also show 'Dictation done — review before saving' although nothing was dictated, and sign-in after a session revoke has no 'your session ended' message. The scan-error part repeats in OAT-03/S22. Not in dev report §5 (that lists only the Quick Dictation / Pending Tasks dialog names).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S22

Every empty and failure screen passes axe, is announced, and fits phone widths and WebKit

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：failure.spec.ts + states.ts: one fresh account; empty lists (Hospital, NH Today's Visits, NH All Residents), no-note Post-Round, summary-failure editor, Generate-blocked reason, note failure (Generate with ai/notes:generateNote failed at the socket), billing error (suggestBilling failed), Ask AI error (askChart failed), scan error (scanCensusSheet failed + public/favicon.png) in both contexts; microphone blocked (cloud engine, getUserMedia refused, prepareSession held), offline banner (context.setOffline), sign-in after a central session revoke (sessions:_revokeForEmail on the case's own local account). Each: screenshot, axe (all impacts), live-region check on the failure message, names of +/scan/Settings on empty lists, phone layout (overflow, message on screen/not truncated, control size 24 px / 44 pt on iPhone). [2026-10-14 review] Layout now judges the four checks the oracle names (overflow, covered, truncated, tap ≥ 24 px; tap is measured on phones) on every profile, not only overflow on phones; key controls (Close editor, Save Note, Dictate, the retry) are judged reachable and not covered (reachable(): scrolled to the middle, topmost element at its centre); 'covered' treats a fixed/sticky layer over another fixed/sticky layer as high (scrolling cannot clear it). Generate is pressed in the note-failure state: ai/notes:generateNote is answered 'fail' at the socket, so no model is called. The covered check also stops its clip-box walk at a position: fixed ancestor (a full-screen editor inside the chart's scroll box was wrongly treated as clipped, which hid the NH microphone toast over the editor header), and content behind a full-screen layer is low (not the screen under test). — Everything the oracle names is scripted; the vision-review comparison of the screenshots is evidence for a person, and U14's iOS/Android native apps are a device check (browser emulation here).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 438 judged check(s) passed, 98 failed. States reached on all three profiles: empty lists (Hospital, NH Today's Visits, NH All Residents), no-note Post-Round, summary failure, Generate-blocked reason, note failure, billing error, Ask AI error, scan error (both contexts), microphone blocked (both), offline banner, sign-in after a session revoke. Announced correctly: NH summary failure (role=alert), both Generate-blocked reasons and note failures (role=alert), Ask AI error (role=alert), billing card (aria-live=polite), offline banner (role=status), NH microphone message. Not announced: Hospital summary failure, Hospital microphone message, both scan errors. Empty-state messages are recorded only (the oracle asks announcement of failure messages). Since the review, every state judges covered / overflow / truncated / tap and its key controls (Close editor, Save Note, Dictate, retry) reachable and not covered.

产品问题：A VoiceOver/TalkBack user is not told about three failures: the Hospital 'The reviewed note is saved, but its structured summary needs another attempt. Tap Save Note to retry.', the Hospital 'Microphone access is blocked…' and the scan 'The photo couldn’t be read…' (both contexts) appear as plain text, not role=alert/status (EFS rows 'Pre-round summary failed', 'Microphone permission denied', 'unreadable photo'; oracle: message in role=alert/status). On phones (Pixel 7, iPhone 15), with the microphone blocked in Nursing Home, the red 'Microphone access is blocked…' toast sits over the full-screen editor's header: the title 'Pre-round notes' and the Close editor (X) button are under it until the physician dismisses the toast with its 20×20 px X (judged: covered = 0, Close editor reachable and not covered, tap ≥ 24 px; EFS 'clear message telling the physician what to do next'). The Nursing Home empty list's '+' (add resident) and Settings buttons have no accessible name — a screen reader says only 'button' (EFS 'Empty patient list … a way to add patients'). On iPhone the add/scan buttons are 32–36 px, Retake photo 98×24, Save Note 36–40 px tall, under the 44 pt the oracle sets; on Pixel 7 the unnamed 20×20 px close (X) of the Ask sheet and the scan sheet fails WCAG 2.5.8 (it passes the spacing exception in the iPhone WebKit layout). Plus the cross-cutting contrast failures (axe = 0 required).

只记录的格子（recorded）：With the microphone blocked, both pre-round editors also show 'Dictation done — review before saving' next to 'Microphone access is blocked…' although nothing was dictated (vision-review flagged, confirmed by eye; contradictory, EFS 'clear message telling the physician what to do next'; source: the dictation onEnd calls onFinished even after an error). Sign-in after a central session revoke shows the plain sign-in form with no 'your session ended' message (EFS 'Session expired … sign-in prompt'; for a person). vision/failure-states: suspicions for a person.

证据：附了 20 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/EFS_S22 — 目录（139 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), which refuses dev, and its failure states need the action-observer mocks, setOffline and a backdated session; so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
